# Check the number of events for each tournament for Brian Watts
events_by_tournament = df.set_index('tournament')['events']

# Identify the tournament with the second highest number of events
# Sort values in descending order and get the second highest
sorted_events = events_by_tournament.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the tournament name at the second position (index 1)
second_highest_tournament = sorted_events.index[1]

# Check if the second highest tournament is 'the open championship'
answer = (second_highest_tournament == 'the open championship')
